{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Sturdy leather armor''' is a stronger leather set crafted from [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. It has Projectile Protection, 2 safe fall distance per piece, and the boots add step height and [[Trailblaze]].

== Obtaining ==
The pieces are the [[Sturdy Leather Helmet|helmet]], [[Sturdy Leather Gambeson|gambeson]], [[Sturdy Leather Leggings|leggings]] and [[Sturdy Leather Boots|boots]]. They are repaired with tattered leather.

=== Chests ===
[[Shipwreck]] supply chests give the pieces.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/equipment/sturdy_leather/armour.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/shipwreck_supply.json}}</ref> The [[village]] tannery's loot table, which once gave a piece from an older, weaker version of the set, is empty, and no other table rolls those older pieces.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/village/village_tannery.json}}</ref>
